Khardung La.desc: One of the world's highest motorable passes (~17,580 ft) on the Leh–Nubra road. It is the gateway to the Nubra Valley and a standard photo stop; travellers report snow even in summer and recommend acclimatising before crossing. (sourced from r/CarsIndia Ladakh trip report)

Nubra Valley.desc: A high-altitude desert valley north of the Khardung La pass, famous for the Diskit Monastery, the Hunder sand dunes and double-humped Bactrian camels. It is usually the first permitted destination after Leh for foreigners. (sourced from r/SoloTravel_India group-ride report)
